conditions.displayName: At least one Hush HTTP 5xx in 15 minutes

conditionThreshold.filter: metric.type="logging.googleapis.com/user/hush_http_5xx_count" AND resource.type="k8s_container" AND resource.labels.cluster_name="hush-m5" AND resource.labels.namespace_name="hush" AND resource.labels.container_name="hush"

documentation.content: Hush emitted an HTTP 5xx response. Check the Hush Milestone 6 dashboard and Logging metric hush_http_5xx_count, identify the request ID and release SHA, then inspect the application rollout. If this follows a deploy, verify public HTTPS /ready and the authenticated smoke path before deciding whether to roll back.
